answer: Reaching eligibility takes 42 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an attacker pays for every seat it wants. The pigment register is checked at draw time, vine lists the eligible set, and forge seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 42 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. Honest users pay that once, farms 32 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
